title: Yellow Glazed Saudi Arabian Nectarine Flatbread
description: A sweet and savory flatbread featuring nectarines and a hint of Saudi Arabian spice, perfect for a light and refreshing snack or dessert. This dish is whole30-friendly and made with double-rise bread.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the double-rise bread into 1-inch thick rounds.
In a small bowl, mix together the honey, lemon juice, and cardamom.
Brush the mixture onto the bread rounds, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Top each bread round with diced nectarines.
Drizzle the ghee over the nectarines.
Sprinkle the salt over the top of each flatbread.
Bake the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the bread is lightly toasted and the nectarines are tender.
